probe_result: Within the exact finite symbolic scope, a plain reusable predecessor-version token is not ABA-safe. A strictly monotone generation coupled atomically to the immutable target digest prevents stale or ABA-restored pointer observations from republishing an obsolete artifact because the CAS compares the full current pair. Unavailable/unknown pointer reads must be a fail-closed no-write state; treating surprise/uncertainty as authorization to retry would reintroduce unsafe publication. Crash-before-CAS and crash-after-CAS remain restart-idempotent under read-before-retry.
mechanism_revision: Make the canonical latest pointer self-identifying as (generation,target_digest), require generation monotonicity/non-reuse, and use full-pair CAS. On restart, read and verify the pointer before any write. If the read is unavailable or unverifiable, emit no mutation and carry an exact cross-invocation continuation rather than polling or guessing. Local confirmation remains derived bookkeeping, not publication authority.
scope_guard: Positive evidence does not cover stores whose CAS token can be reused or rewind, CAS that does not compare the target digest, multi-pointer transactions, pointer deletion/recreation that resets generation, Byzantine/forged current reads, torn multi-field pointer writes, garbage collection races, append/send/increment effects, or any external irreversible effect before canonical state is durable.
